findings.text: `after-1920.png` was taken before commit 83cea8187: its task rows still show "from owner", which the final code removed (session.jsonl log, 02:50:30). The proof shows an older build than the one that will merge, so retake it before or after the merge.

The page now reads `prompts.jsonl` twice: once through `PromptLog.read` for Coverage (`AISessionDetail.js`, the `coverage.read_records` line) and once through the new `SessionTimeline.Tail`. The brief only banned a second read of the record, so this is allowed, but Coverage could use the tail's lines and drop the extra fetch.

`SessionTimeline.js:192-195` gives `KINDS`, `HIDDEN`, `rows` and `landed_of` new names that only point back to `SessionTimelineRows`. Calling `SessionTimelineRows` directly would make the code shorter and easier to follow.

At 390 px the tab chips now wrap to three rows (`path-6-deputy-timeline.png`: Overview…Tasks / Cost…Related / Task queue). The sticky stats bar also takes about 285 px, roughly a third of the screen, and covers the top of the list (`after-390.png`). The minion found the stats bar problem, but it was outside their brief, so it needs its own task.

The Timeline list scrolls inside its own box (`.stl-list` max-height 72dvh, `SessionTimeline.css:135`), and the page scrolls around it. At 1920 this leaves blank space under the list (`after-1920.png`), and a phone gets two scroll areas.

Some docs already listed the detail page's tabs and classes but were out of date before this change: `ai/sessions/doc/ui/detail-layout.md:3` still names the old Conversation tabs, and `ai/sessions/doc/ui/classes.md` lists none of the Session* tab classes. This diff didn't break them, but the Timeline is missing there too.

The minion's log says core/Session readmes are now stale because `on_session` passes `(session, lines)`. I grepped every .md under `public/framework`: only `ai/AISession/readme.md` mentions `on_session`, and that file is updated. Nothing is stale.

The `StoreFolder.js` change is outside the brief: redirect targets are no longer treated as moved tasks. It is the real cause of the short-id hang, it is recorded in session.jsonl (02:50:00), and `known()` loads `moved("/")` first, so `_task_dirs` always exists before it is read.
